description: This file is a C header file that declares exported function prototypes related to Web URI Path object, including creation, removal, enrollment of objects, and initialization functions. It appears to be part of a larger codebase implementing web server client or application components.

methods.name: WebCreateUriPath
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a Web URI Path object, given container and owner contexts.

methods.name: WebUpoCreate
methods.description: Constructs a new Web UPO (URI Path Object) instance with given context handles.

methods.name: WebUpoRemove
methods.description: Removes or deletes a Web UPO object identified by the handle.

methods.name: WebUpoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers objects within the Web UPO context.
